payload.title: Wavelet Analysis with Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to perform wavelet analysis and wavelet coherence using the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on analyzing the EPICA Dome C ice core record and its coherence with atmospheric CO2 data. The notebook covers loading and visualizing data, performing wavelet transforms, customizing frequency ranges, and conducting significance testing. It also explores the relationship between temperature proxies and CO2 levels through wavelet coherence analysis.
goals: Perform wavelet analysis and wavelet coherence in Pyleoclim
Analyze wavelet and coherence for evenly- and unevenly-spaced data
Learn about Scalogram and Coherence classes
Establish significance of scalogram or coherence
Interpret results of wavelet and wavelet coherence analyses

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook begins with an introduction to wavelet analysis and its relevance in climate timeseries analysis, particularly in the context of paleoclimate studies.
section_blurbs.heading: Notebook start

section_blurbs.blurb: Introduces the Pyleoclim library and sets up the environment by importing necessary libraries such as numpy, pandas, matplotlib, and pyleoclim.
section_blurbs.heading: Wavelet Analysis with Pyleoclim

section_blurbs.blurb: Demonstrates loading the deuterium dataset using Pyleoclim's utility functions, converting time units, and visualizing the data with metadata for proper labeling.
section_blurbs.heading: Loading and visualizing $\delta D$ series

section_blurbs.blurb: Performs wavelet analysis on the standardized deuterium series to obtain a scalogram, which is then visualized to show spectral power changes over time.
section_blurbs.heading: Wavelet Analysis

section_blurbs.blurb: Focuses the wavelet analysis on specific frequency ranges to highlight oscillations in the 5-200kyr range, using customized frequency parameters.
section_blurbs.heading: Customizing the frequency range

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains methods for testing the significance of wavelet power using AR(1) benchmarks, including parametric and simulation-based approaches.
section_blurbs.heading: Significance Testing

section_blurbs.blurb: Loads and visualizes CO2 data from Antarctica, then compares it with the deuterium series to explore potential lead/lag relationships using wavelet coherence.
section_blurbs.heading: Temperature vs $CO_2$

section_blurbs.blurb: Analyzes the coherence between temperature proxies and CO2 levels, including phase statistics and significance testing of coherence results.
section_blurbs.heading: Wavelet Coherence

section_blurbs.blurb: Summarizes the capabilities of Pyleoclim for wavelet and wavelet coherence analysis, highlighting the handling of both evenly- and unevenly-spaced data.
section_blurbs.heading: Takeways

inputs: EPICA Dome C ice core deuterium data
